rule: All resolved places remain selectable with a score; only independently audited settlements scoring 60 or more appear as town markers.

additions.name: Kirkton (Balmerino)
additions.rationale: Kirkton is assessed separately from Balmerino Abbey, Gauldry and Bottomcraig, with no neighbouring attraction or service transferred into its score.
additions.resolutionNote: Resolved to Kirkton in Balmerino parish at NO362251 and labelled Kirkton (Balmerino) to avoid the other catalogue localities named Kirkton.

additions.name: Bottomcraig
additions.rationale: Bottomcraig remains a distinct selector entry and does not inherit Balmerino Abbey, Gauldry facilities or wider Tay routes.

additions.name: Kilmany
additions.rationale: Kilmany is assessed on its own church, memorial, village environment and current facilities, without borrowing Cupar, Rathillet or private nearby properties.

additions.name: Rathillet
additions.rationale: Rathillet is scored as the present hamlet; documentary medieval history and nearby private estate land do not become visitor attractions without access evidence.
additions.resolutionNote: The requested spelling is normalised to Rathillet.

additions.name: Hazelton Walls
additions.rationale: Hazelton Walls is retained as a named rural place and does not inherit Creich Castle, Brunton heritage or distant visitor businesses.

additions.name: Creich
additions.rationale: Creich is assessed on publicly appreciable in-boundary heritage; Brunton, Luthrie and wider parish attractions remain separate.

additions.name: Brunton (Creich)
additions.rationale: Brunton is assessed as a conservation hamlet with its own built heritage; Creich Castle, Luthrie services and wider parish scenery are not transferred.
additions.resolutionNote: Resolved to the conservation hamlet in Creich parish and labelled Brunton (Creich), not Brunton near Markinch.
